title: The Loopy Polynomial: from Tutte's Universal $V$-Function to Bizonotopal Geometry
summary: We study the loopy polynomial L_G, a multivariate graph invariant arising from bizonotopal graphical algebras and defined by deletion and loopy contraction, in which the contracted edge is retained as a loop. It determines the Tutte polynomial and admits a spanning-forest expansion recording external activity componentwise. It also determines Stanley's chromatic symmetric function for every graph; the degree sequence, induced edge count profile, and independence polynomial for loopless graphs; and the clique and matching polynomials for simple graphs.
